entries.page_or_table: p. 5032, Fig. 4D (Fig. 4C gives the H2 rate, 18.7 mol H2 gcat-1 h-1 at 40 bar, 550 degC)
entries.note: uncertainty about +/-0.2 mol gcat-1 h-1. Reader arithmetic: the plotted values equal X x (F/W) x P/bar with F/W = 0.368 mol gcat-1 h-1 (30 mL min-1 at 24.45 L mol-1); e.g. 0.845 x 0.368 x 40 = 12.4. The molar NH3 converted per gram at fixed feed is X x F/W (at most 0.37-0.40 mol gcat-1 h-1) and FALLS with pressure. The abstract's 'productivities and TOFs 40 times bigger' at high pressure follows from this pressure multiplication, not from a larger measured molar output.
